kjv: he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth
mine: he had also descended into the lower regions, the earth
note: TR adds "proton" (first); and "the lower parts of the earth" is probably appositional ("the lower regions, namely the earth", i.e. the incarnation), though the KJV wording has long been read as a descent into hell.

kjv: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying
mine: to equip the saints for the work of ministry, for building up
note: The three prepositions are not parallel (pros … eis … eis): leaders equip the saints, who do the work of ministry. The KJV's commas make all three the clergy's tasks; this is the famous "fatal comma".
